newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany sends condolences to Israel over crash.
newsitem.headline: Germany sends condolences to Israel over crash.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel sent a message of condolences on Wednesday to Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy over the mid-air collision of two military helicopers in which more than 70 soldiers died.

"I was deeply shaken to learn of the tragic helicopter accident that took the lives of so many Israeli soldiers," Kinkel said in a telegram message. "In the name of my countrymen, I would like to express my deep sorrow.
"In this hour of sadness for Israel, our thoughts are with the families of the victims," Kinkel said.
